title: Mankanya language
description: Bak language of Guinea-Bissau, Senegal and The Gambia
extract: The Mankanya language is spoken by approximately 86,000 people in Guinea-Bissau, Senegal and Gambia primarily belonging to the ethnic group of the same name. It belongs to the Bak branch of the Atlantic–Congo language family.
